format: Rows: [source_key, street_or_place, house_number, city, postal_code, longitude, latitude]. WebMercator tiles at zoom 12. Gzip JSON.
coverage: Available addressed OSM nodes, ways and multipolygon relations from the Germany extract. No guarantee of complete real-world addresses. Missing house numbers/street-or-place and invalid geometry are excluded. No inferred resident or household data.
